disease_state.evidence: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is the most common motor neuron disease and still lacks effective disease-modifying treatments.

material_type.evidence: Here, we performed a multiomic analysis of the prefrontal cortex from 51 sporadic ALS patients and 50 control subjects, as well as from four transgenic mouse models of C9orf72-, SOD1-, TDP-43-, and FUS-ALS to characterize early disease mechanisms in ALS.
